TaskDescription: Instructed-delay out-and-back reaching to targets on a touchscreen with the left arm; one block of 40 trials (release description).
Instructions: Prepare to move to the cued target during the delay; after the imperative signal touch the screen near the target and return to the start position (paper).
InstitutionName: University of California, Irvine (UCI) Medical Center
iEEGReference: Not documented in the release. The paper re-referenced to the common average and notch filtered at 60/120/180 Hz before analysis; whether these exports include those steps is not stated.
RecordingDescription: Authors' export at 1000 Hz (acquisition rate at this site: 5000.0 Hz per the paper). Release session code IR89_LC1_2; source file L3_LeftHemisphere_LeftHand_2.mat.
